name: frontend-dependency-contract
body: Each of the eight apg language frontends (Go, Java, C++, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python, Markdown) must have its dependency contract stated in the durable spec: (a) its build-time dependencies, (b) its scan-time dependencies (what must exist on PATH when a user runs `apg scan`), and (c) the pinned engine whose version sets the language-version ceiling. The declaration is attached to that frontend's solution container, whose body names the code units that carry each dependency, so "to scan X you need Y and Z" is answerable and traceable from the spec. The contract is declarative: delivery is the container bodies plus the durable dependency-matrix note, and the change-set's only code delta is the documentation update claimed by `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (README.md / AGENTS.md). The frontend containers and the build pipeline therefore carry no `implemented-by` claim — this change-set does not change frontend or build code, and their absence from the code-coverage surface is deliberate so the verify gate does not demand `modifies` tasks over untouched code. (Before this change-set only four of the eight frontends had containers — go/java/ts/py — and none named its build-time deps, scan-time deps, or engine pin.)
